intent: Standalone sign-in / sign-up page: centred Card with Field-wrapped email and password, one primary submit, optional 'or' Divider and SSO buttons. Presentational: the app passes callbacks.

mode.note: sign-up adds a Name field, drops Remember me and Forgot password, and swaps the copy.

providers.note: { id, label, icon? } — secondary block Buttons under Divider label="or". icon is a Lucide export name. Omit for email only.

onSubmit.note: (values: { email, password, name?, remember? }) => void. Called only after required and email-format checks pass.

onForgotPassword.note: Shows 'Forgot password?' (tertiary sm) in sign-in mode.

onSwitchMode.note: (next: mode) => void. Shows the footer switch link.

error.note: Server failure. Danger Alert above the form.

loading.note: Primary disabled with a busy label; SSO disabled; form aria-busy.

requirements: Tab order: (name) → email → password → remember → forgot → primary → SSO → switch link
Enter in any input submits (form with a type=submit primary)
Validation errors go through Field error; focus moves to the first invalid input
The form is noValidate so browser bubbles never replace Field errors

doNot: Do not put this inside the app shell (no AppHeader, no SideNav); it is a full page on surface.page
Do not add more than one primary Button; SSO is secondary, forgot and switch are tertiary
Do not skip Field wrappers on email, password, or name
Do not invent a local divider or 'or' rule; use Divider label="or"
Do not use Card footer actions for submit; the primary lives inside the form
Do not call an auth API or store credentials in the pattern; pass callbacks
Do not use raw hex or brand-coloured SSO buttons
snippet: <SignInPattern productName="Agentix" providers={[{ id: "google", label: "Continue with Google" }]} onSubmit={(values) => signIn(values)} onProvider={(id) => sso(id)} onForgotPassword={() => {}} onSwitchMode={setMode} />
